name: com.paradedb/mcp
title: ParadeDB
description: Search and read ParadeDB documentation and website content.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search ParadeDB docs and website pages with keywords or a question. Returns titles, URLs, and excerpts. Use get_page to read a page.

query.description: Keywords or a question, e.g. 'BM25 ranking' or 'How do I install ParadeDB with Docker?'.

section.description: Filter by section. Use docs for installation, SQL syntax, and deployment.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read a page as Markdown by path, URL, or slug. Find pages with search_content or list_content.

path.description: Page path, URL, or slug, e.g. '/docs/start/install' or 'bm25'.

tools.name: list_content
tools.description: List docs and website pages with titles and URLs. Optionally filter by section.

section.description: Filter by section. Use docs for installation, SQL syntax, and deployment.

tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: Get a structured overview of ParadeDB: what it is, how to install it, and key links (docs, GitHub, blog). Useful for grounding before answering questions.
